# pve_apt_update_status (Data Source)

Pending APT package updates of a node (the readable counterpart of the update action).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_apt_update_status" "example" {
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
- `updates` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/apt/update. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--updates))

<a id="nestedatt--updates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `updates`

Read-Only:

- `arch` (String) Package Architecture.
- `description` (String) Package description.
- `notifystatus` (String) Version for which PVE has already sent an update notification for.
- `oldversion` (String) Old version currently installed.
- `origin` (String) Package origin, e.g., 'Proxmox' or 'Debian'.
- `package` (String) Package name.
- `priority` (String) Package priority.
- `section` (String) Package section.
- `title` (String) Package title.
- `version` (String) New version to be updated to.
